question: Same processes (P1 (10, 15, 6), P2 (15, 5, 3), P3 (20, 10, 2)). Using nonpreemptive priority scheduling (1 is highest), P2 finishes execution at time:

Processes (arrival, burst ms): P1 (0, 6), P2 (1, 5), P3 (4, 3). Two queues. Q1: RR q = 3 ms, highest priority; an unfinished process moves to the end of Q2. Q2: nonpreemptive SJF. Scheduling between queues is preemptive priority; a preempted process goes to the end of Q2. Initially all arriving processes go to Q1. A process whose waiting time reaches 8 ms is upgraded to the next higher queue. Give the sequence of execution.
answer: P1 0-3, P2 3-6, P3 6-9, P2 9-11 (Q2, shorter), P1 11-14 (upgraded at t=11 after waiting 8 ms). Sequence: P1-P2-P3-P2-P1.
